document.abstract: Edit. Note: The USASI Standard PH1.28 for archival film on cellulose base has recently been revised by the USASI Sectional Committee PH1. The USASI represented by P. Z. Adelstein, USASI Chairman of Subcommittee of PH1-3, believes the proposed standard is of interest to SMPTE members and it is published herewith. This standard will also be published in the SPSE News and in the Journal of the National Microfilm Association.
